race.description: The Big Dance Day 3rd November 2026 (Bm66) Hcp
race.comment: JOIKA (3) did well to score two runs ago then turned in a nice run last time out when second over 2300m at Newcastle, beaten only 0.8 lengths. Hoop Bullock sticks in the irons and is nicely placed to play a leading role again. FULMEN FILOU (1) turned in an eye-catching run over this journey last time, settling out the back before winding up late to finish 2.75 lengths away in fourth at Tuncurry. Will drift back again but is going to be hard to hold out late at odds. IMMORTAL ROSE (5) has won three of her past four and it's hard to knock mares in form. In the mix. CALZINO (4) won two starts back at this track but missed the frame last start, beaten 2.75 lengths into seventh over 2300m at Newcastle. Hard fit and can feature.
